name: qwen-outpaint-v0
purpose: Establish whether the bundled Qwen outpainting blueprint can extend a cropped character photograph while preserving the original canvas.

stages.prompt: Continue the existing photograph downward, completing the seated subject's lower legs and feet with anatomically consistent proportions and continuing the gym equipment and floor. Do not alter existing pixels outside the feathered boundary.
stages.notes: The stock workflow completed both legs and feet, added plausible shoes and floor, continued the gym machine, and showed no obvious horizontal seam despite internal feathering remaining at zero. It resized and subtly regenerated the original canvas, including shirt, body, and facial detail, so it passes semantic scene extension but fails strict pixel-preserving outpainting.

Recompositing preserved the original region but created a conspicuous horizontal boundary through both thighs and the gym machine. The strict-preservation variant is rejected until the workflow exposes a usable overlap or feathering control.

decision_rule: Accept semantic outpainting when continuation_plausibility and scene_continuity are at least 4. Accept production outpainting only when original_canvas_preservation is also at least 4.
conclusion: Qwen is accepted as a generative outpainting backend. Strict source recompositing is rejected because zero-feather compositing creates a severe boundary seam; the stock generative path remains the default.
